geometry: Installed C3, extra 6 g wire/glue estimate, 90-degree hinges
algorithm: PPO warm-start with target-normalization correction, then 33,792 additional steps
flat_base_behavior: gyro-qualified low-pass accelerometer level detector, ease both targets to zero at <=2 rad/s, hysteretic return to recovery
held_out_criterion: base within 8 degrees, actual joints within 0.12 rad, targets within 0.05 rad, mean angular speed below 0.4 rad/s and resting base for 1 s. Resting includes <=0.5 mm solver contact gap; angular speed smoothed over ~100 ms.
comparison_note: Stricter arm goal and different stability filtering from historical base-only results; scores are not directly comparable.
servo_mapping: Extrapolated from measured zero/+/-45-degree references; actual 90-degree endpoint accuracy not newly measured.
